answer: In Proof of Agent networks, multi-agent auditing illuminates identity graphs like a lantern, dispelling the fable of cheap identities. Nodes stake capital to attest neighbor integrity; topological cut verifications detect sparse graph bottlenecks where Sybils cluster. When an audit discovers fraudulent subgraphs, coordinated stake slashing penalizes all colluding entities, making the attacker cost scale superlinear with network size. The penalizing echo strips capital across every counterfeit peer simultaneously.
